segments.title: Sao không báo tôi sớm?
segments.content:
"I did inform you."

"I'm talking about signing the contract. I was still arranging the due diligence team, and you've already signed the contract and faxed it over!"

"It's a startup company with no external business. I could complete the due diligence with just my finance and legal teams. You're too slow, and I couldn't be bothered to wait."

"This attitude of yours is terrible! I will inform the founding partner of IDG China, as well as the partner who invested in you."

"Be my guest."

The very day Chen Guiliang arrived in the Magic City, Lin Dongliang called again.

Hearing he was in the Magic City, Lin Dongliang didn't mention the investment. He only said he wanted to treat Chen Guiliang to a meal and have him meet IDG China's founding partner, Xiong Xiaoge.

Out of respect for the capital tycoon, Chen Guiliang made a point of asking before heading to the appointment, "Is it okay to wear a T-shirt and shorts? It's been too hot in the Magic City these last two days, I really can't bring myself to go out in a suit."

"Haha, no problem," Lin Dongliang said with a laugh. "I'll arrange for a place with no dress code."

It really was hot this summer.

The Magic City was already a furnace, and this year the temperatures hit a new historical high. It only rained for four days during the plum rain season, and then it stayed hot all the way until autumn.

Upon arriving in the Magic City, Chen Guiliang immediately bought himself a new outfit: a T-shirt, shorts, and sandals.

"Driver, to No. 803 Julu Road. Shintori."

"Okay."

The taxi drivers in the Magic City were quieter than those in Beijing, and also more formally dressed.

Even more formally than Chen Guiliang.

Shintori was a Western-style Japanese restaurant opened by a Taiwanese businessman.

Chen Guiliang wasn't a fan of this kind of stuff. He figured he wouldn't get full today and would have to grab a bowl of noodles on the way back to the hotel.

The environment was quite nice, situated in a bamboo garden, with a certain Zen quality of finding tranquility amidst the bustle.

But the architecture inside was modern industrial, and they even threw in art installations. Paired with cool-toned lighting, it created a futuristic and minimalist space.

It was particularly in line with the aesthetic of a certain crowd: not quite Eastern, not quite Western, touching on everything but belonging to nothing, yet possessing an inexplicable air of class.

The waiters' attire was also very Westernized, not the typical Japanese-style clothing of a normal Japanese restaurant.

When Chen Guiliang walked in wearing shorts and sandals, the waiter was visibly taken aback for a moment, then greeted him, "Hello, sir. Do you have a reservation?"

"A friend booked a private room. His last name is Lin."

"Alright, please follow me."

The private rooms here had to be booked in advance.

There were very few private rooms; most guests dined in the main hall.

The waiter leading Chen Guiliang was clearly taking a roundabout route, using an inconspicuous path to the private room to prevent Chen Guiliang's attire from affecting the other diners.

The atmosphere here was still relatively casual. If he were dining at restaurants like Three on the Bund, he wouldn't even be allowed in dressed like this.

Three people were seated in the private room.

Besides Xiong Xiaoge and Lin Dongliang, there was another person he didn't recognize.

Seeing Chen Guiliang's attire, the three of them exchanged a look. They all understood that Chen Guiliang was doing it on purpose: adopting a posture unsuited for the dining scene to imply that IDG should meddle less in ByteDance's affairs in the future!

"Mr. Chen," Lin Dongliang introduced with a smile, "This is Mr. Xiong Xiaoge, the founding partner of IDG China."

Chen Guiliang stepped forward to shake his hand. "Hello, Mr. Xiong."

Xiong Xiaoge was all smiles. "Mr. Chen is truly young and promising."

Lin Dongliang then introduced, "This is Mr. Zhang Suyang, an investment partner at IDG. He has invested in Ctrip, EachNet, Allyes, Wumart, and Home Inn. His investment acumen is truly exceptional."

"Hello, Mr. Zhang."

"Hello, Mr. Chen."

Lin Dongliang said, "We heard that your collaboration with Director Hu was not pleasant, so we've decided to replace the director on ByteDance's board with Mr. Zhang Suyang."

"I couldn't be more pleased," Chen Guiliang smiled.

Zhang Suyang had joined IDG back in 1994. He was very senior and held a position in the investment world, capable of keeping Chen Guiliang in check when it mattered.

This fellow often argued with people in board meetings.

At the same time, Zhang Suyang didn't sweat the small stuff. As long as Chen Guiliang didn't cross his bottom line, he wouldn't interfere too much, because he himself didn't play much by the rules.

He was like the most suitable director chosen specifically for Chen Guiliang.

The previous one loved to run his mouth. After ByteDance's financing round, a board meeting was held, and that director was still there pontificating during the meeting.

"Let's order," Xiong Xiaoge said.

The three of them quickly ordered, but Chen Guiliang didn't know what to eat.

The dishes at this Western-style Japanese restaurant were quite unique.

Seeing Chen Guiliang's hesitation, the waiter took the initiative to introduce, "The foie gras sushi is our restaurant's creative specialty, combining French foie gras with Japanese sushi. The foie gras is seared, making it rich and oily, and paired with vinegared rice and a red wine sauce, the taste is rich and delicate..."

Seared foie gras, vinegared rice sushi, paired with a red wine sauce. Chen Guiliang felt it sounded like some kind of bizarre cuisine.

As the dishes were introduced one by one, most were a fusion of Japanese and Western styles.

The waiter repeatedly mentioned molecular gastronomy, and Chen Guiliang couldn't help but ask, "What is molecular gastronomy?"

The waiter explained, "Molecular gastronomy studies the relationship between temperature changes and time during the cooking process of food, adding different substances to cause physical and chemical changes in the food. After fully mastering this, it is deconstructed, reconstructed, and applied. Take this slow-cooked salmon, for example. Its foam sauce is in the molecular gastronomy style. You can choose from wasabi foam or miso foam."

"I don't want anything with molecular gastronomy," Chen Guiliang said. "I'll have a sashimi platter, truffle beef carpaccio, wagyu roll with foie gras, and teppanyaki lobster with sea urchin sauce... No sake, I'll have a creative cocktail."

Xiong Xiaoge smiled without saying a word.

First, he had the waiter explain molecular gastronomy, and after the person went on at length, he said he didn't want anything with molecular gastronomy.

He was still expressing his dissatisfaction with that Director Hu, telling IDG to interfere less in specific matters in the future!

After ordering, Chen Guiliang took out a contract and handed it to Zhang Suyang, saying, "Mr. Zhang, since you're taking over the director's position, you can look over this contract directly."

Zhang Suyang took it and looked, surprised. "You've invested in another company?"

"Yes, if I see something good, I invest. No need to let the funds sit in the bank earning interest," Chen Guiliang said.

Zhang Suyang read it carefully and passed the contract to Lin Dongliang.

At this point, the dishes were being served. Chen Guiliang picked up a piece of tuna sashimi to dip in soy sauce, and the waiter reminded him, "Adding a little wasabi will make it taste even better."

"Your service is very thoughtful, but I'm not used to wasabi. Thank you."

Chen Guiliang wasn't trying to be subtle this time; he really couldn't stand wasabi.

Xiong Xiaoge said to the waiter, "You can leave us for now."

"Please enjoy your meal," the waiter said with a smile and withdrew.

Xiong Xiaoge asked, "Mr. Chen, why are you so optimistic about that company, Bailian Technology?"

Chen Guiliang said, "This company was founded because of a game idea I proposed. I'm confident it will make money."

"The registration date for this company seems to be early last year, right? You were still in your third year of high school then," Zhang Suyang said.

Chen Guiliang said, "I proposed the game idea in 2003. For a fee! I was just a poor student back then, taking my idea to a local boss. This boss bought the idea for over a hundred thousand yuan and scraped together everything he had to make the game the following year. What do you think of this game idea?"

"To make someone bet their entire fortune, it must be brilliant. I won't ask any more then," Zhang Suyang said, but then he asked about Tudou.com, "What about this video website?"

Chen Guiliang said, "Another major innovation of Web 2.0. I estimate that by next year, twenty or thirty similar websites in the US and China will likely pop up all at once."

"You're that confident?" Xiong Xiaoge chuckled.

Chen Guiliang said, "UGC is the future mainstream trend for video websites. Moreover, Xiaonei and Tudou can create synergy. This kind of website burns through cash, and I hope IDG will invest next year as well."

With Chen Guiliang putting money in early and providing a clear development model, Tudou's growth rate should be even faster than in the other timeline.

Perhaps it could go public before 2008, instead of being dragged through several rounds of financing!

Lin Dongliang, who was reading the contract, suddenly asked, "Why is there a prenuptial agreement clause for the founder?"

Chen Guiliang smiled. "Just in case. If the founder doesn't sign a prenup, the director I appoint automatically gets veto power, and the founder has to give up 10% of their equity to compensate me."

Lin Dongliang was at a loss for whether to laugh or cry. "Unheard of."

The three of them asked a few more questions about Tudou, which Chen Guiliang answered generally.

After that, they didn't inquire further, chatting about investment topics while they ate.

The cocktail was even worse than the sake, so Chen Guiliang switched to a pot of sake halfway through. The teppanyaki lobster with creamy sea urchin sauce tasted strange, but was surprisingly delicious.

Chen Guiliang thought he wouldn't get full, but he ended up eating until he was stuffed.

After the satisfying meal, Zhang Suyang suggested going to a club, but Chen Guiliang politely declined and left directly.

Watching Chen Guiliang get into a taxi, Lin Dongliang asked, "What do you think?"

Xiong Xiaoge said, "He's cut out for investment. He's bold, has a keen eye, and a very sharp business sense. As long as he doesn't go too far, we shouldn't interfere with ByteDance anymore."

"Sigh, I was just worried he was young and inexperienced, so I had Old Hu speak up more in the board meetings and help keep an eye on the projects," Lin Dongliang sighed. "I didn't expect him to react so strongly and deliberately not cooperate with Old Hu's work."

"He's a young man. Sudden success can easily make one arrogant and unwilling to listen to advice," Zhang Suyang said.

In the taxi.

Chen Guiliang had had a little to drink. Gazing at the bustling night view of the Magic City, he suddenly felt like going to the Bund for some fresh air. "Driver, to the Bund."

The evening rush hour had passed, so the traffic was decent.

Chen Guiliang got out at the Bund and strolled around. Looking at the brightly lit shores on both sides and the not particularly large number of tourists, the alcohol's effect washed over him, creating a surreal feeling of being in a different lifetime.

He leaned on the railing, staring blankly at the river water for a long time.

He couldn't help it. After drinking, his artistic melancholy was having an intermittent flare-up.

"Hello, could you help us take a picture?" a young couple came over.

Chen Guiliang smiled and took the camera. "Move a little to the left, yes... now get a bit closer..."

Teacher Chen's photography skills were very professional. He had been an undercover reporter in his past life and had specifically studied photography in journalism school.

If the opportunity arose, he could even dabble in the art of nude photography in the future.

*Rebirth in the Wild Era* is now available on Hongguo Short Plays. Ahem, those who have time can go critique it. Don't blame me if you don't like it.

(End of this chapter)
